issues.detail: 04_shaders.js pyM's height mask (1.4-1.7 m) cools only the upper part of the PY face of the J/PY bulkhead. Above the monitor row the panel reads +19 B-R, below it +4..+7. Across one flat white panel, which is what the PY row-1 passengers face, this shows as a bluish top and a grey bottom. The fixer noted this but left it. py_37301 / py_37303 show the PY lower whites cool as well (+25..+36 in rows 150-450), so cooling the lower panel would also match the photos.
issues.problem: Vertical hue ramp (+19 -> +4 B-R) on the PY bulkhead face behind the monitor row
issues.fix: In pyM, drop the height gate for vertical monument faces that face the PY cabin (e.g. use (1 - smoothstep(1.4, 1.7, y)) only for |n.y| > 0.5, or lower the gate to 0.5-0.8 m for faces with n.z > 0.5 inside the PY zone). Keep the forward-facing gate that protects THE Room's face. Target: jpC column profile within +-3 B-R from y250 to y570, the bulkhead J face in jpB unchanged (-15 / -14), q13 / q14 seat backs unchanged (B/R 1.38 / 1.30).
